test_command: cd apps/web && npx playwright test --config tests/post-m1-phase-10-fixture-playwright.config.ts; RHYTHM_LIVE_E2E=1 npx playwright test --config tests/gateway/post-m1-phase-10-live-playwright.config.ts --workers=1; cd ../api_server && npx vitest run src/__tests__/post_m1_phase_10_error_redaction.test.ts --no-file-parallelism; cd ../electron && node --test test/post-m1-phase-10-packaged-resilience.test.mjs; cd ../.. && node --test tools/validation/post-m1-phase-10-review-matrix.test.mjs

criteria.text: Every completed top-level, nested, Profile, and Tool route derives its surface state exclusively from ready, loading, empty, server-error, forbidden, unavailable, or readonly; no other route-state literal is accepted or persisted.
criteria.reason: Pending exhaustive route-state vocabulary proof in apps/web/tests/post-m1-phase-10-route-states.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: Each route renders loading during its initial request and every retry, ready for a non-empty successful result, and empty only for a successful empty result, without mounting seeded rows or fixture identity in live mode.
criteria.reason: Pending initial-load, retry, successful-result, and no-fixture-fallback proof in apps/web/tests/post-m1-phase-10-route-states.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: A 5xx response or bounded terminal timeout renders server-error with a working retry; an offline or unavailable dependency renders unavailable with a working check-again action; neither path replaces retained authorized data with fixtures.
criteria.reason: Pending deterministic error/unavailable recovery proof across all routes in apps/web/tests/post-m1-phase-10-route-states.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: A 401 and a 403 both use forbidden while remaining behaviorally distinct: 401 offers session refresh or sign-in, 403 offers no mutation; a protected 404 uses unavailable and discloses no resource existence or restricted data.
criteria.reason: Pending unauthorized, forbidden, and non-disclosing not-found mapping proof in apps/web/tests/post-m1-phase-10-route-states.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: Readonly preserves authorized inspection while disabling every mutating control, and a failed mutation preserves the last acknowledged server value plus any unsent draft until an explicit retry succeeds or the user discards it.
criteria.reason: Pending cross-route readonly and mutation rollback/draft-retention proof in apps/web/tests/post-m1-phase-10-mutation-recovery.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: Unknown hash routes and missing detail resources fail boundedly through unavailable and expose recovery navigation without accepting an invented route-state literal or leaking the requested identifier into telemetry.
criteria.reason: Pending unknown-route and missing-detail recovery proof in apps/web/tests/post-m1-phase-10-route-states.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: Real API and engine disconnect, refusal, slow response, and restart reach loading, unavailable, or server-error within measured bounds and recover to ready or empty without a duplicate request, duplicate mutation, or fixture fallback.
criteria.reason: Pending serial live disconnect/slow/restart timing and duplicate-side-effect proof in apps/web/tests/gateway/post-m1-phase-10-faults.live.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: After a live agent WebSocket closes, React opens at most one replacement socket with bounded backoff, retains a bounded ordered outbound queue, reports any overflow, resubscribes once, refetches authoritative session state, and delivers each accepted input at most once.
criteria.reason: Pending Flutter-parity WebSocket reconnect, bounded queue, resubscribe, rehydrate, and at-most-once proof in apps/web/tests/gateway/post-m1-phase-10-websocket-recovery.live.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: A malformed HTTP body or WebSocket event is isolated to the affected request or event, renders server-error when user action is required, leaves the transport and other routes usable, and never commits partial state.
criteria.reason: Pending malformed HTTP/WebSocket isolation proof in apps/web/tests/gateway/post-m1-phase-10-faults.live.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: Every API failure used by React follows error:{code,message,correlationId?}; raw Git stderr, provider exception detail, OAuth errors, request bodies, headers, bearer/session tokens, OAuth codes, API keys, stack traces, and absolute paths appear in no response, renderer text, receipt, or serialized test artifact.
criteria.reason: Pending API envelope and end-renderer disclosure audit in apps/api_server/src/__tests__/post_m1_phase_10_error_redaction.test.ts and apps/web/tests/gateway/post-m1-phase-10-redaction.live.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: A live 401 invalidates only the rejected authenticated session and returns to forbidden with sign-in recovery; a 403 and protected 404 preserve the session, do not trigger sign-in, and remain non-disclosing across retries.
criteria.reason: Pending multi-status session and non-disclosure proof in apps/web/tests/gateway/post-m1-phase-10-authorization.live.redspec.ts.

criteria.text: The unsigned packaged app loads its bundled renderer with the network offline, renders unavailable rather than fixtures for live data, preserves navigation and sign-in recovery, and contacts no protected or fixture test port before an explicit reconnect.
criteria.reason: Pending packaged cold-offline launch, no-fixture, and protected-port proof in apps/electron/test/post-m1-phase-10-packaged-resilience.test.mjs.

criteria.text: After Google sign-in, Electron stores the live session only in an OS-protected host-owned store, restores and validates it on relaunch, retains it across offline validation failure, deletes it after a definitive 401 or logout, and never exposes it through preload globals, DOM, localStorage, logs, or fixture configuration.
criteria.reason: Pending Flutter-parity secure authenticated relaunch and disclosure proof in apps/electron/test/post-m1-phase-10-packaged-resilience.test.mjs.

criteria.text: The packaged Electron host owns or explicitly resolves the live API and engine lifecycle, reaches a bounded unavailable/server-error state when either cannot start, retries or reconnects without touching protected ports, and terminates every host-owned child on quit.
criteria.reason: Pending Flutter-parity packaged API/engine supervision, retry, isolation, and shutdown proof in apps/electron/test/post-m1-phase-10-packaged-resilience.test.mjs.

criteria.text: Offline, reconnect, and relaunch preserve the rhythm://app origin/path policy, frozen preload allowlist, context isolation, sandboxing, and navigation, popup, permission, and download denials without widening the renderer network or native boundary.
criteria.reason: Pending packaged policy-invariance proof across every recovery transition in apps/electron/test/post-m1-phase-10-packaged-resilience.test.mjs.

criteria.text: Relaunch restores only persisted state authorized to the restored user, drops stale user/profile/session selection when identity changes, and never restores fixture rows, fixture identity, pending mutations, or data belonging to another user or workspace.
criteria.reason: Pending two-identity packaged relaunch and stale-state isolation proof in apps/electron/test/post-m1-phase-10-packaged-resilience.test.mjs.

criteria.text: Every one of the 689 baseline review rows has a reviewed retained, manual, or still-planned disposition with an explicit evidence owner, and each of the 246 Phase 10 rows resolves to evidence that exercises the named behavior rather than a line or fixture-state declaration.
criteria.reason: Pending full baseline and Phase 10 disposition audit in tools/validation/post-m1-phase-10-review-matrix.test.mjs.

criteria.text: Terminal alone remains deferred; every other behavior family has retained executable evidence or a still-planned owner whose phase contract is pending, and no review row is silently dropped, self-certified, or assigned to an unrelated fixture test.
criteria.reason: Pending deferred-family and ownership exclusivity audit in tools/validation/post-m1-phase-10-review-matrix.test.mjs.

criteria.text: The matrix validator rejects stale Flutter source SHA, stale React source hashes, duplicate review-row ownership, unsupported surface-state literals, missing evidence files, and any pass disposition whose test does not collect the row.
criteria.reason: Pending provenance, vocabulary, ownership, collection, and freshness proof in tools/validation/post-m1-phase-10-review-matrix.test.mjs.

criteria.text: A hermetic Phase 10 scan produces byte-identical review dispositions and provenance when unrelated tracked and untracked files contaminate the working tree, without deleting, staging, or reading those contaminating files as parity input.
criteria.reason: Pending contamination-order and byte-identity proof in tools/validation/post-m1-phase-10-review-matrix.test.mjs.
